Question: The sequence \((a_n)\) is defined recursively by \(a_0=1,\) \(a_1=\sqrt[19]{2},\) and \(a_n=a_{n-1}a_{n-2}^2\) for \(n\ge2.\) What is the smallest positive integer \(k\) such that the product \(a_1a_2\cdots a_k\) is an integer?
